entities.name: Ulrich
entities.description: Werewolf alpha of the Krallenhorde howlpack on Innistrad, an unlikely ally of humanity during the Travails.

entities.name: Krallenhorde
entities.description: Innistrad's largest howlpack before the dire pack.

entities.name: Vildin Pack
entities.description: Pack some of whose members escaped Emrakul's corruption and joined the Krallenhorde.

entities.name: Travails
entities.description: Crisis in which Ulrich allied with humanity.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose corruption affected the Vildin Pack.

events.summary: Ulrich leads the Krallenhorde against the mutated Dronepack, becoming an unlikely ally of humanity.
events.quote: leading his howlpack against the mutated horrors of the Dronepack

events.summary: Vildin Pack members who escaped Emrakul's corruption join the Krallenhorde.
events.quote: A few members of the Vildin Pack who had escaped Emrakul's corruption also joined forces with the Krallenhorde

relations.quote: Ulrich is the alpha of the Krallenhorde pack of werewolves.
